messages:
sara (docs): Quick bug: API ref for /v1/generate currently shows request examples using a top-level `prompt` string in several language snippets, but the runtime and OpenAPI schema expect `input` (object or array) now. This is causing a lot of confusion in examples and a few user reports.

kevin (sdk): Which snippets? I remember we switched the canonical shape to `input` during the v2 drive but kept aliases in SDKs. Docs should reflect the canonical shape.

sara (docs): Found `prompt` in: docs/reference/generate.md curl, python, go, and the openapi example. The curl example is like:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \ \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \ \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-generate-1","prompt":"Write a short haiku"}'
```
But server v2 expects `input: ["Write a short haiku"]` or `input: {"text":"Write a short haiku"}` depending on model. The `prompt` alias is still accepted by some backends but not guaranteed.

omar (api): Confirmed. During the schema consolidation we introduced a flexible `input` field to support structured inputs and multimodal payloads. For backwards compatibility some engines accept `prompt`, but the OpenAPI validator and newer models require `input`. We intentionally standardized on `input` to avoid ambiguity.

nina (pm): Impact: users following the top-of-page curl or Go snippets may hit a 400 or see silent misrouting to legacy model variants. Let's fix docs asap and add a migration note. Do we need runtime changes?

omar (api): No runtime change planned. We should not reintroduce `prompt` as canonical. Better to fix docs and have SDKs map `prompt`->`input` for a transition period.

kevin (sdk): I can add a compatibility layer in SDKs: if `prompt` provided, map to `input` and emit a deprecation log. Will update Go/Python/Node helpers and examples. I'll open a combined docs+sdk PR so they land together.

sara (docs): Proposed doc updates: 1) Replace `prompt` examples with canonical `input` array/object examples. 2) Add short migration note: "If you previously used `prompt`, switch to `input`. SDKs will map `prompt` to `input` for now but may drop support." 3) Update the OpenAPI example and the param table to show both shapes (preferred: `input`). 4) Add a small Go snippet showing how to build an `input` array for batch prompts.

ci-bot: PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1024 by kevin (sdk) 2 checks triggered (lint, example-tests).

kevin (sdk): PR includes: updated docs/reference/generate.md curl/python/go/node examples, added migration note under "Breaking changes", updated SDK helpers to normalize `prompt` -> `input`, unit tests for mapping, and a preview link.

sara (docs): Nice. Can we also add a one-liner in the API reference that `input` may be either a string, an array of strings (batch), or an object for structured inputs, with example for each? That should reduce copy-paste bugs.

omar (api): Good call. Also add a note: when sending structured objects, the model may expect a particular key (e.g., `text` or `content`) — link to model catalog for per-model input shape.

ci-bot: docs lint found one formatting nit in the Go example. kevin (sdk) pushed fix.

ci-bot: All checks passed for PR #1024.

kevin (sdk): Merged. I've also published SDK patch versions with the mapping and deprecation warning.

sara (docs): Draft release-note blurb: "Docs: standardized generate endpoint examples to use `input` (string|array|object). If you used `prompt`, switch to `input`. SDKs will map legacy `prompt` values during the migration window. See docs PR #1024."

nina (pm): LGTM. Mention the model catalog link in the final blurb.

sara (docs): Will post to #announcements and update the quickstart snippets in the tutorial repo. Closing thread 20thanks everyone!
